result.summary: WF-03 step 5, REVIEWER, read only, over git diff base/ISS-0132-20261123-01 b76ca6e -- tools/ (13 changed files + the new module platform-guard.js = the 14 files of the write set), read in full against docs/design/ISS-0132-platform-guard.md and the gate step-03b. Verdict derived from my own reading (AP-018). Q1 cause: the fix refuses at the entry (G1-G5, floor guard first, guard is the next statement in the same function; pixel-office after its help branch, note after its help branch), the second layer is check() rule 1 in claude-cli.js, and the mode is read back after chmod in ensureHome and ensureStateDir with a refusal (E_HOME, E_STATE_DIR) and the notice pushed only after the read-back holds; nothing is swallowed, no symptom is hidden (the only swallowed write is the guard's own stderr write, as in node-floor.js). Q2 design/decisions: every changed line traces to a design section (2, 3.1, 3.2, 4, 5, 6); the texts (module line, E_PLATFORM rows in EXECUTOR_MESSAGES, PREFLIGHT_CODES, WHY_NOT_STARTED, the two read-back messages, the README section Platforms and the two rights lines) are word for word as in the design; the three parallel E_ tables (errors.js, api.js, texts.js) all carry E_PLATFORM (AP-014); Node 22, ES modules, no dependencies (0002) kept; nothing ported to Windows (0127, 0134). Hook: the drop (await import of the guard, then return when unsupported) is the first statement of run(), before config.js, stdin, resolveStateDir, readSecret and the request, so the L3 place is right; a failed import ends in the existing catch and quit(). Module: no word `import`, no `node:`, no process.env or fs (grep empty), `process.platform` only as the default of the guard's second argument; the fixer's comments there honour L1. Q3 extras: none; no generalisation, no setting, no test file touched; the file list equals the write set. Q4 quality bar: grep for skip, todo, eslint-disable, `|| true` over the added lines is empty; no check step touched. Word-scanning tests (CTL-1c, CTL-5a, WEB-9d, WEB-14, TM-49, TR-4b, TR-4c, E2K-02, NF-01 and the 22.n.n rule), applied by my own read-only grep to the added lines of src and test/e2e: no appendFile, writeFile, createWriteStream, openSync, rename, inbox, child_process, channel, engineHolder, deliver, node:http/https/net/tls/dgram, fetch(, require(, sqlite, 22.n.n, URLs; web files hold only the three single-row edits. Q5 idiom: naming, error classes and messages as the neighbours (homeError, StateDirError, executorError, Russian texts); prettier --check and eslint --max-warnings 0 pass on the 13 JS files and on README.md; npm run -s traces 0 (3002 files, 0 traces), handoffs-check 0 violations. Tests are not run here (decisions/0110); their record is the GitHub run (design section 15). For TEST-DESIGNER: PLT-04 (no `import` word in the module, comments included) is green on my grep; HK-41 should keep the drop first (before config and state); the read-back rows need an fsImpl that ignores chmod (design 9.1); the platform seam of check() is `io.platform ?? process.platform`.
